answer: One concrete defense is a rate limit on new identities tied to proof of past work: each agent must post a small bond that only unlocks after reviewers with unrelated funding confirm its outputs over several epochs. A sybil swarm minted overnight from one wallet looks like a dune of identical sand grains, same funder, same timing, so the ledger merges them into one voice. Velvet-smooth fake reviews cannot buy history, and a copied answer, as obvious as juniper on pine, slashes every linked bond.
